# reci

> Compile declarative CI recipes into fully-wired GitHub Actions workflows with typed data-flow validation.


## Pages in this subsection

- [reci](reci.html.md): reci — Compile declarative CI recipes into GitHub Actions workflows.
- [reci.action_spec](reci.action_spec.html.md): Action contract model — parsed from &#96;action.yml&#96; metadata.
- [reci.adapters](reci.adapters.html.md): Config adapter registry.
- [reci.adapters.base](reci.adapters.base.html.md): ConfigAdapter protocol — interface for reading/writing CI config.
- [reci.adapters.package_json](reci.adapters.package_json.html.md): PackageJsonAdapter — reads &#96;"ci"&#96; key from package.json.
- [reci.adapters.pyproject](reci.adapters.pyproject.html.md): PyprojectTomlAdapter — reads &#96;&#91;tool.ci&#93;&#96; via tomlkit, round-trip preserving.
- [reci.adapters.wads](reci.adapters.wads.html.md): WadsAdapter — reads &#96;&#91;tool.wads.ci&#93;&#96; for backward compatibility.
- [reci.adapters.yaml_adapter](reci.adapters.yaml_adapter.html.md): YamlAdapter — reads &#96;.ci.yml&#96; via ruamel.yaml.
- [reci.compiler](reci.compiler.html.md): Compiler — recipe + action specs + config → GitHub Actions workflow YAML.
- [reci.config](reci.config.html.md): Config resolution — flat dict with scoped overrides.
- [reci.graph](reci.graph.html.md): Recipe DAG — computational graph built on &#96;graphlib&#96;.
- [reci.recipe](reci.recipe.html.md): Recipe model — declarative CI pipeline description.
- [reci.recipe_checks](reci.recipe_checks.html.md): Whole-recipe checks that need the recipe text and the config, not the step graph.
- [reci.validation](reci.validation.html.md): Validation system — ESLint-style severity, ruff-style rule prefixes.
- [reci.validation.formatters](reci.validation.formatters.html.md): Output formatters for validation reports.
- [reci.validation.report](reci.validation.report.html.md): Core validation data structures.
- [reci.validation.rules](reci.validation.rules.html.md): Validation rule registry and runner.
- [reci.validation.rules.action](reci.validation.rules.action.html.md): Action metadata validation rules (ACT001–ACT003).
- [reci.validation.rules.config_rules](reci.validation.rules.config_rules.html.md): Config validation rules (CONF001–CONF003).
- [reci.validation.rules.dag](reci.validation.rules.dag.html.md): DAG structure validation rules (DAG001–DAG004).
- [reci.validation.rules.flow](reci.validation.rules.flow.html.md): Data-flow validation rules (FLOW001–FLOW006).
- [reci.validation.rules.purity](reci.validation.rules.purity.html.md): Purity validation rules (PURE001–PURE003).
- [reci.yaml_gen](reci.yaml_gen.html.md): YAML I/O wrapper using ruamel.yaml (YAML 1.2).
